headline: Methuen School Committee to vote on E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy and a related city ordinance resolution.
summary: The meeting covers staff reports, a second reading and approval vote on the E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy, and a resolution asking the Methuen City Council to adopt an ordinance on electric bicycles and micromobility devices on city property. The committee will also review finance, grants, and personnel items.
items: Assistant Superintendent of Teaching and Learning Update
Assistant Superintendent of Finance and Operations Update
Assistant Superintendent of Student Services Update
Student Enrollment Report & Enrollment Comparison Report
Director of Human Resources - Staffing Updates, Data Breach Update
Motion to remove E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy from the table
Second reading and approval vote on E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy
Resolution calling on Methuen City Council to adopt an ordinance on electric bicycles and micromobility devices on city property (Sponsor: Member Baez)
Negotiation Committee Nominations/Appointments - Approval for Unit B Administrators, Unit D Secretaries, Cafeteria Employees, Nurses
Student Activity Accounts - CGS, MARSH, TIMONY, TENNEY, METHUEN HIGH
Warrants - Acceptance of Warrant Reports for 09/04/2026, 09/11/2026, 09/18/2026, 09/24/2026, 10/02/2026
New FY27 Grants/Donations/Gifts Approvals: MHS Booster Donation, Grant Funds and Donations
Notification of Appointments and Other Personnel Matters
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA 01844
